1909 is not a leap year (1900–2099 rule: divisible by 100 but not 400 → not leap).  
28 weeks + 5 days = 28×7 + 5 = 196 + 5 = 201 days.  
Subtract 201 days from 1909-09-05:  
September 5 → back 5 days → August 31 (1909-08-31).  
Remaining 196 days: go back month by month:  
August 31 → July 31 (31 days back) → June 30 (30 days) → May 31 (31 days) → April 30 (30 days) → March 31 (31 days) → February 28 (28 days) = total 181 days.  
196 − 181 = 15 more days back from February 28 → February 13.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1909-02-13
